Read in Packages

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(coin)
library(rstatix)

```

Read in and Process Performance Data

```{r}

#Read in performance data

perf <- fread(**Add file path for Performance_data.txt**)

perf

#Pull out team brainstorming idea performance data and calculate worst, median, and best

teams <- filter(perf, Trial.Type == "Team", Phase == "Brainstorming Phase")


worst <- group_by(teams, Unit) %>%
  summarize(Score = min(Score)) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Worst")

med <- group_by(teams, Unit) %>%
  summarize(Score = median(Score)) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Median")

best <- group_by(teams, Unit) %>%
  summarize(Score = max(Score)) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Best")


all_ideas <- rbind(worst, med, best)

all_ideas


```

Produce Graphs

```{r}


n_fun <- function(x){
  return(data.frame(y = 16.5, label = length(x)))
}



a <- ggplot(perf, aes(x = Trial.Type, y = Score, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_boxplot(size = .3, outlier.size = .5) +
  ylab("Performance") +
  xlab("Condition\n ") +
  #scale_fill_grey(start = .4, end = .9) +
  theme_light() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Phase")) +
  ylim(0,16.5) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(.3, 'cm'), legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.title = element_text(size=8), legend.box.spacing = margin(0.5), axis.text=element_text(size=8), axis.title=element_text(size=8)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = n_fun, geom = "text", aes(group = Phase), position=position_dodge(width=0.75), size = 2) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = .4, end = .9, name = "Phase", labels = c("Brainstorming", "Design"))

a



all_ideas$Type <- factor(all_ideas$Type, levels = c("Worst", "Median", "Best"))


b <- ggplot(all_ideas, aes(x = Type, y = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(size = .3, outlier.size = .5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ylab("Performance") +
  xlab("Relative Brainstorming Track \n Performance per Team") +
  scale_color_grey(start = 0, end = .4) +
  theme_light() +
  ylim(0,16.5)  +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text=element_text(size=8), axis.title=element_text(size=8)) +  
  #legend.key.size = unit(.3, 'cm'), legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.title = element_text(size=7), legend.box.spacing = margin(0.5)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = n_fun, geom = "text", position=position_dodge(width=0.75), show.legend = FALSE, size = 2) 

b


cowplot::plot_grid(a, b, labels = c("a)", "b)"), rel_widths = c(.6, .4), nrow = 1, ncol = 2, label_size = 7)


```


Calculate Statistics

```{r }

head(perf)

hist(perf$Score)

#Compare Brainstorming Phase track performance across individuals and teams

team_brain <- filter(perf, Trial.Type == "Team", Phase == "Brainstorming Phase")
indi_brain <- filter(perf, Trial.Type == "Individual", Phase == "Brainstorming Phase")

wilcox.test(team_brain$Score, indi_brain$Score)

rbind(team_brain, indi_brain) %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ Trial.Type)

```


```{r }

#Compare Design Phase track performance across individuals and teams

team_design <- filter(perf, Trial.Type == "Team", Phase == "Design Phase")
indi_design <- filter(perf, Trial.Type == "Individual", Phase == "Design Phase")

wilcox.test(team_design$Score, indi_design$Score)

rbind(team_design, indi_design) %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ Trial.Type)

```




```{r }


#Compare team score in Design Phase to worst brainstorming track performance

team_design_rename <- dplyr::rename(team_design, Team_Score = Score) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Phase, -Trial.Type, -ResponseID)

worst_rename <- dplyr::rename(worst, Worst_Score = Score) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Type)

team_worst <- data.frame(merge(team_design_rename, worst_rename, by = c("Unit")))

wilcox.test(team_worst$Team_Score, team_worst$Worst_Score, paired = TRUE)

rbind(data.frame(Type = "Team", Score = team_worst$Team_Score), data.frame(Type = "Worst", Score = team_worst$Worst_Score)) %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ Type, paired = TRUE)

```


```{r }

#Compare team score in Design Phase to median brainstorming track performance

med_rename <- dplyr::rename(med, Median_Score = Score) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Type)

team_med <- merge(team_design_rename, med_rename, by = c("Unit"))

wilcox.test(team_med$Team_Score, team_med$Median_Score, paired = TRUE)

rbind(data.frame(Type = "Team", Score = team_med$Team_Score), data.frame(Type = "Worst", Score = team_med$Median_Score)) %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ Type, paired = TRUE)

```


```{r }

#Compare team score in Design Phase to best brainstorming track performance

best_rename <- dplyr::rename(best, Best_Score = Score) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Type)

team_best <- merge(team_design_rename, best_rename, by = c("Unit"))

wilcox.test(team_best$Team_Score, team_best$Best_Score, paired = TRUE)

rbind(data.frame(Type = "Team", Score = team_best$Team_Score), data.frame(Type = "Worst", Score = team_best$Best_Score)) %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ Type, paired = TRUE)

```
